units.source_text: 这样实在也是无可奈何啊。

en.t: This too is truly something that cannot be helped.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，也还会被问到为什么会做梦。

en.t: Even so, one may still be asked why dreams occur.

units.source_text: 那是因为还没有真正全部被吞没，虚空里有不便，暂时不能尽其用的缘故。

en.t: That is because one has not yet truly been swallowed up entirely, and because there is some inconvenience in the void, so for the moment it cannot be fully put to use.

units.source_text: 但是，毫无疑问，还是进入了虚空。

en.t: But without a doubt, one has nevertheless entered the void.

units.source_text: 其证据是，你觉得那个梦是事实，你感到流汗、悲伤或喜悦。

en.t: The proof is that you feel that the dream is real, and you experience sweating, sorrow, or joy.

units.source_text: 当尽其用后，就全然是虚空了。

en.t: Once it has been fully used, it becomes entirely void.

units.source_text: 你说不曾记得，但不论你如何固执己见，也是没办法的啊。

en.t: You say you do not remember, but no matter how stubbornly you insist, nothing can be done about it.

units.source_text: 但是，眼睛却是明亮地注视着，你会觉得仿佛挽回了自己的躯体。

en.t: But the eyes gaze brightly, and you feel as though you have recovered your own body.

units.source_text: 如果不包含这种思索，并寄托于此种虚空的力量，那就无法活下去。

en.t: Without holding this kind of reflection within yourself and entrusting yourself to the power of such a void, you cannot go on living.

units.source_text: 正是从眼睛到鼻子再到口的来回反复，才这样看、嗅、听和动作。

en.t: It is precisely through the repeated movement from the eyes to the nose and then to the mouth that one sees, smells, hears, and acts in this way.

units.source_text: 这种自由自在是谁在做呢，这是谁在操作手推车呢？

en.t: Who is carrying out this freedom of movement, and who is operating this handcart?

units.source_text: 天车绕天一周，整个世界都在动，这是个巨大的天车。

en.t: The celestial cart circles the heavens once, and the whole world is in motion; this is an enormous celestial cart.

units.source_text: 连这也不知，如何才能自由，甚至厚着脸皮说：

en.t: Not even knowing this, how could one be free, and yet one even has the shamelessness to say:

units.source_text: 我就是躯体，我就是物，我就是家，撒谎不知羞耻地那样说。

en.t: I am the body, I am the thing, I am the house, speaking such lies without any sense of shame.

units.source_text: 要唤醒这种睡迷糊的人，让他们睁开眼。

en.t: Such drowsy, confused people must be awakened and made to open their eyes.

units.source_text: 一休和尚说，在七月的精灵祭上，他提到：

en.t: The monk Ikkyu said that at the spirit festival in July, he spoke of this:
